title: QuickSnap
body:
# QuickSnap

**Take a screenshot. Get a link. Share it anywhere without leaving Minecraft.**

QuickSnap replaces Minecraft's screenshot key with something actually useful. Hit F2, get a shareable link in your clipboard. That's it.

## How it works

Hit F2 like normal. A small popup slides in from the corner with four options:

- **1** -- upload and copy the link
- **2** -- copy the image to clipboard (Windows only)
- **G** -- open the gallery
- **Esc** -- dismiss

The popup stays open while the upload runs and shows you the result. When it's done the link is already in your clipboard.

---

## Gallery

Press G any time to open your screenshot gallery. Screenshots are sorted by world automatically. From here you can upload, copy, delete, edit effects, open the folder, or jump into settings.

Arrow keys to navigate, E or Enter to open a screenshot in the full viewer.

---

## Overlay Effects

Want to stamp info onto your screenshots before sharing? You can. Everything is off by default -- turn on what you want:

- Coords, biome, dimension, weather, time, moon phase
- Health, hunger, XP, game mode, held item, player name
- FPS, GPU, resolution, shader pack, resource pack, mod count
- Timestamp, world name, difficulty, Minecraft version
- Custom watermark

Effects get baked in at upload time. Your original PNG on disk stays untouched. And if you've already applied effects to a screenshot, you can still go back and turn them off before uploading -- nothing is permanent until you actually share it.

---

## Providers

| Provider | Notes |
|---|---|
| QuickSnap *(default)* | Hosted at screenshot.rest. Permanent. |
| Imgur | Needs a free Client ID in settings. |
| Litterbox | Temporary, expires after your chosen duration. |
| Custom | Point it at your own endpoint. |

---

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.1
- Fabric Loader
- Client-side only -- no server install needed
- Java 25+

> **Windows only:** Copying the screenshot image (not the link) to clipboard uses a Windows method. It will fail silently on Linux and Mac. Link copying works everywhere.

> **Gallery key:** G can be rebound in Options -- Controls.

---

## Analytics

First launch shows a one-time prompt asking if you want to share usage data. If you say yes, only the upload provider name gets sent -- nothing else. No usernames, no IPs, no screenshot content. Turn it off any time in settings.
